content: Yisambwali yi batu bakesolu mu wamuse bilumbi

Mu temu eni, durangu du badukitsi dumafunaange. Kaboghu baSwife abamavosaange mbembu baNgereke, bakengugerene mu djowu abamavosaange mbembu baEberu. Mumbari bakwili ba baNgereke, bamafwimbungu mu bighudji abimaghabungu kale yilumbu.
Dighumi na babedji bakenengile yinombu yi badukitsi nobatsingule riye: «Dighadiwelimine yi tukedunde ulonze musamu wu Nzambi mughabaange bighudji.
Ladibandu, baane ba tadji, solanu yisambwali yi babaale bavu na bumbedji buboti, babase na Yinyuni Yisyeme na dyele. Tukebaveghe yisalu yeni yine.
Tumbe djetu, tuvyosaange temu mu dusambu nolonze musamu Nzambi.»

Dibundu dyotsu dikesinge ditase dyeni. Bakesole Yityene, dibaale dibase na Yinyuni Yisyeme, divu na yitu yandi yotsu mu Nzambi. Bakemwésole Filipe, Porekore, Nikanore, Timone, Paremenase na Nikolase, mwise Atyose dji Siri, djandi awu amasinge Nzambi baSwife.
Bakebawakise ombu bilumbi, bakebasambilile nobasakighe makake.
Mbembu Nzambi djimanyavaange. Durangu du badukitsi dumafunaange o Serusaleme, na pwele bavaghulitsi ba paghu bamavayilaange Djesu yitu.
Na mangolu na yese yi Nzambi amamuveghe, Yityene amalasaange bilimbe novaghe bimaghe bineni va ghari mukute.

Mwa dikabu di batu, bakemutsundise. Djowu batu ba ndaghu dusambu adjimanengulu «Bavighe abamadjeghusu». Mu ndaweni, mumabe baSwife ba misyengi mi Sirene na Alesanderi. Dikabu dimosi baSwife ba binange bi Silisi na Asi.
Tumbe basamarungule ughaghene nandi, mumbari amavosaange na dyele di Yinyuni Yisyeme.
Kaboghu bakefute batu muyéfure bumbedji yi: «Tutsimughulu esyengi Moyise na Nzambi.»
Anane bamarulile batu botsu, bivunde bi mukute na milonzi mi mighaghe. Mba bakesutusu Yityene nomughange, bakemubeghe va wusu fundu dji banzonzi.
Bakebeghe bambedji ba ufure, abamavose yi: «Mutu éwuwu aghedundi ulenze ndaghu adjisyeme dji Nzambi, na mughaghe Moyise!
Tutsimughulu evosi yi Djesu mwise Nasarete, opanze ndaghu Nzambi na osanze mutsanu awu Moyise amasile.»
Batu botsu abamabe va ghari fundu dji banzonzi, bamalabe yinzi yi Yityene yimabaghunu nane ayi yanze.
